p1.texto: Analyze this image of cattle skin inside a circular PVC pipe. Find the precise bounding box of the exposed dark skin patch in the center. Ignore white labels. Return the coordinates as [x1, y1, x2, y2].

p2.texto: Identify the central dark spot (hair or skin) within the circular area. Disregard any alphanumeric tags. Output bounding box format: [x1, y1, x2, y2].

p3.texto: Find the dark skin lesion or hair sample inside the PVC pipe hole. Provide the bounding box coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2] strictly for the biological sample, ignoring the white background and text.

p4.texto: Detect the central biological specimen (dark skin/hair). Focus only on the circular opening. Do not detect the PVC pipe or the printed text labels. Format: [x1, y1, x2, y2].

p5.texto: Locate the dark region of interest in the center of the image. The object is a cattle skin patch. Return its bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2].
